title: Navan Review (2026)
intro: Navan (formerly TripActions) is a corporate travel and expense platform for mid-market and enterprise teams — flight/hotel/car booking, policy enforcement, expense capture, approvals, and reporting. Pricing is quote-based (2026-08-19): no universal public rate card; typical packaging is per active traveler or company contract. Scored in the HR cluster as finance-ops adjacent — not a core HRIS or payroll product. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Navan when corporate travel volume and T&E control are the bottleneck — treat it as finance/HR ops adjacent, not your system of record for employees.
verdict: Choose Navan when corporate travel volume and T&E control are the bottleneck — treat it as finance/HR ops adjacent, not your system of record for employees. Compare Bolt for Business for ground transport; Jibble if time tracking is the primary job; BambooHR or Rippling if you still need core HRIS. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Is Navan HR / workforce software?
faq.answer: No — not in the HRIS sense. Navan is corporate travel and expense management (booking, policy, approvals, reporting). Finance and HR ops teams often own the rollout, but it is not your system of record for employees, payroll, or benefits.

faq.question: How is Navan priced?
faq.answer: Quote-based enterprise travel & expense — request demo for traveler/seat packaging. Not a published self-serve HRIS price list.

faq.question: Does Navan have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Navan?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
